items.name: Gargoyle_1
items.description: Stone gargoyle statue holding a long pole.
items.how_to_get: Rename a carved pumpkin to "Gargoyle_1" in an anvil (exact spelling and capitals).
items.stacking: Copies with the same name stack. Add 1 to 3 spaces to the end of the name to keep a copy separate.

behaviour.in_hand: Small 3D model, shrunk in first person so it does not block your view.
behaviour.other_players: Everyone sees the same 3D model.
behaviour.item_frame: Put the frame on the floor: the statue stands upright, about as tall as a player. On a wall frame it sticks straight out. Its name tag is hidden in the frame. Taken back out, it keeps its model but no longer stacks with freshly renamed copies.
behaviour.head_and_armor_stand: It is a carved pumpkin, so it can be worn on a head or put on an armor stand head and shows the model there. The wearer gets the orange pumpkin view overlay.
behaviour.placed_as_block: Placing it puts down a normal carved pumpkin. Breaking that gives back a plain carved pumpkin: the name and model are lost.
